# wellbeing_surveys (Data Source)

Lists the company's surveys.

Useful for discovering the id of a survey created outside Terraform before importing it. Questions are not included — the list endpoint omits them; use `terraform import` or read the survey resource for the full definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every survey in the company.
data "wellbeing_surveys" "all" {}

# Only the live ones.
data "wellbeing_surveys" "active" {
  state = "active"
}

output "active_survey_ids" {
  value = { for survey in data.wellbeing_surveys.active.surveys : survey.name => survey.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `state` (String) Optional filter: only return surveys in this state (`draft`, `active` or `inactive`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The company ID the provider is configured with.
- `surveys` (Attributes List) The surveys, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--surveys))

<a id="nestedatt--surveys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `surveys`

Read-Only:

- `definition_id` (Number) Survey definition ID.
- `end` (String) End of the survey window.
- `frequency` (String) How often the survey runs.
- `id` (String) Survey ID.
- `name` (String) Survey name.
- `start` (String) Start of the survey window.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
